Targeted pass of a 279-page BREF: TOC, Ch.1.1-1.4, Ch.2.2 drying and refining, 2.3.2 pressing, 2.6 energy production, Ch.3.1.4 energy consumption (Tables 3.2, 3.3), Ch.4.2.2 dryer techniques (UTWS), 4.6 energy efficiency, Ch.5 BAT 6-7, Ch.6 emerging. Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 20). Main file: specific electricity and heat per m3 finished panel (Table 3.2) for drying (PB, OSB, MDF fibre), refining (MDF) and pressing (PB, OSB, MDF), PB indirectly heated dryer footnotes, MDF per tonne dry fibre (Table 3.3), biomass CHP cost, burner/engine sizes, UTWS and superheated steam dryer descriptions. Not loaded: annual MWh and site-level totals (other-values), all pollutant data and BAT-AELs, abatement equipment costs (WESP, bioscrubber, bag filter, SNCR; non-GHG), water. Traps: (1) values are per m3 of finished panel while archetypes are per t; Table 1.1 densities (ranges) are the only same-source factor; (2) Table 3.2 PB drying range covers direct and indirect dryers, footnotes give the indirect sub-range; (3) heat basis (fuel input vs delivered heat) and heating value not stated; (4) MDF data are dry-process grades only; (5) OSB press heat ND; (6) no GHG emissions data in the document; (7) the 40 MW CHP and other MW sizes do not state input/output basis, thermal-input assumed; (8) no price years, 2016 used. Measures file is header only: no technique has a quantified saving.
